compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story

As the epic owner, the cycle-end arbiter has been triggered on a real PR for this project and we have observed BLOCK/DEFER/DROP rulings produced and processed correctly through the revised workflow, so that SC10 evidence is captured in the epic description and the user's explicit closure condition is satisfied.

## Done Definitions

- [ ] A real PR exists on this project (navapbc/digital-service-orchestra) containing the cycle-end arbiter implementation (Stories 10-14). The PR diff includes a synthetic scenario crafted to exercise cycle-K dispatch: at least one finding that recurs across cycles (triggers STABLE_HALT or max_cycles).
- [ ] CI runs through at least max_cycles=4 cycles OR until STABLE_HALT fires (whichever comes first). PR comments show the extended `DSO-Review-Cycle: K commit_sha=<sha> findings_hash=<h> tuples=<json>` markers for each cycle.
- [ ] Arbiter PR comment posted: visible on PR with marker `DSO-Arbiter-Ruling: cycle=K commit_sha=<sha>`, summary table of per-finding rulings, BLOCK list highlighted.
- [ ] BLOCK demonstration: at least one finding in the scenario receives BLOCK ruling; PR check status reflects this (failure or pending until BLOCK addressed).
- [ ] DEFER demonstration: at least one finding receives DEFER ruling; orphan ticket created via `dso ticket create task --tags=orphan:deferred_review --tags=origin:arbiter`; ticket ID recorded; ticket appears in `dso ticket list --tag=orphan:deferred_review` output.
- [ ] DROP demonstration: at least one finding receives DROP ruling; defense record written to both stores; tracker record visible via `dso ticket comments <ticket>` showing DEFENSE_RECORD with defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter; PR comment visible.
- [ ] Idempotency verified: CI is re-run on the same commit_sha; cycle_dispatcher SHORT_CIRCUIT activates; no duplicate orphan tickets, defense records, or PR comments are created.
- [ ] Epic description updated with 'SC10 Evidence' subsection containing: (a) PR URL; (b) Arbiter PR comment URL; (c) DEFER orphan ticket ID; (d) DROP defense record commit URL or comment URL; (e) BLOCK demonstration PR check screenshot or commit ID showing failed check.

## Considerations

- [Synthetic scenario design] The PR diff needs a finding that the reviewer keeps flagging across cycles. Options: (a) add code that intentionally trips a reviewer pattern (e.g., a TODO that the reviewer flags but the LLM 'fixer' can't resolve); (b) construct a small file with intentional style issue. Choose (b) — controllable and reversible.
- [Cost] Multi-cycle review is several LLM calls. Budget: 4 cycles × ~30s each + 1 arbiter call = ~3-4 minutes of LLM time per scenario. Acceptable.
- [Cleanup] After SC10 evidence captured, the synthetic-scenario commits can be reverted from the PR. Orphan tickets remain (consumed by sibling epic 7271 /dso:cleanup). Defense records remain in tracker.
- [Ordering] Depends on Stories 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 — all wiring + schema must ship before this can execute.
- [Escalation policy] Escalate when blocked.

comments.body:
SC10 UPDATE (2026-05-18) — split for two-tier review surface after remediation epic.

SC10a: Sub-PR arbiter validation
- The cycle-end arbiter fires on a real per-story or per-batch sub-PR when sub-PR LLM review hits STABLE_HALT (Jaccard ≥ 0.85 across 2 cycles) OR max_cycles.
- arbiter-rulings.json sidecar is written to $ARTIFACTS_DIR with cycle_num, commit_sha, and rulings list.
- BLOCK ruling causes the sub-PR's required-check `llm-review` to fail, preventing merge into the session branch.
- DEFER ruling creates an orphan ticket scoped to branch:<sub-branch-name>.
- DROP ruling writes defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter to tracker; PR defense store skipped (sub-PR has no main-PR yet at this point — store layering depends on remediation epic design).

SC10b: Epic-PR (session→main) arbiter validation
- The cycle-end arbiter fires on the session→main PR when incremental-scope review hits halt conditions.
- Incremental scope = (commits on session branch with no DSO-Story-PR provenance trailer) ∪ (files modified by ≥2 sub-PRs).
- If incremental scope is empty (all changes covered by sub-PR reviews), the epic-PR llm-review job exits 0 with an explicit "no integration risk" record (NOT silently SKIPPED).
- arbiter sidecar written with same schema as sub-PR.
- BLOCK ruling fails the required `llm-review` check on session→main.

BLOCKED-BY-EPIC: this story is blocked on epic b575, which is blocked on the remediation epic. SC10a/SC10b cannot be validated until the remediation epic ships the two-tier review surface they describe.
